FN-T47L515-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 325
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Tourism
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 325 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Commerce by
an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in: 1) the annual salary of the Director of
the Alabama Film Office set by the Secretary of the Department of Commerce above the current
$48,000 cap pursuant to the provisions of this bill; and (2) the salary otherwise set by the
Governor under current law.
Page 1

FN-T47L515-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 325
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility & Economic Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/23/2024
House Bill 325 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the administrative
obligations of the Department of Commerce by an undetermined amount to issue sales, use and
lodgings tax exemption certificates to qualified production companies and adopt rules as
necessary to administer the provisions of this bill and would decrease the administrative
obligations of the Department of Revenue by a corresponding amount. Additionally, this bill
could increase the financial obligations of the Department of Commerce by an undetermined
amount dependent on the difference in: (1) the annual salary of the Director of the Alabama
Film Office set by the Secretary of the Department of Commerce above the current $48,000 cap
pursuant to the provisions of this bill; and (2) the salary otherwise set by the Governor under
current law.
